reason: I'm always looking for somewhere indoors to take the kids between naps, and $12 with a drink included is easy to try once. I would not commit to a monthly membership until I've seen how it actually is.
objection: I'll still be chasing my kid, so I won't really get to sit and drink coffee, and with daycare costs up, $59 a month is hard to justify when I could just use the library or a park for free.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial visit, or a membership that works out to cheaper than about 4 drop-ins, and proof that the little ones (under 2) have a safe separate area so I can actually sit down.
